title: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2611.26228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. While this phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time, we ask how head specialization depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, we find that heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. We then study this phenomenon in a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention and establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. translated_title: 注意力头特化：样本复杂度中的相变
translated_abstract: 注意力头在训练过程中会特化为不同的功能，往往随模型行为的急剧变化而分阶段涌现。虽然这一现象大多被作为训练时间的函数来研究，我们则探究注意力头特化如何依赖于可用训练数据的数量。在实证方面，我们发现BERT中特化于句法关系的注意力头会随数据集规模的增大而涌现。随后，我们在一个可求解的多头注意力高维模型中研究这一现象，并证明在该模型中，注意力头特化是样本复杂度意义上真正的相变，对应于测试误差及其他可观测量中的非解析性。根据数据结构和正则化的不同，特化可以跟随无信息量的头分化而发生，或通过一系列级联相变逐步恢复较弱的潜在特征，从而提供了一种统计形式的简单性偏置。
tldr: 该论文证明注意力头特化是样本复杂度中真正的相变，在可求解的多头注意力模型中表现为测试误差的非解析性，且随数据量增加可通过级联相变逐步恢复更弱的潜在特征，形成统计意义上的简单性偏置。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that attention head specialization constitutes a genuine phase transition in sample complexity—manifested as non-analyticity in test error in a solvable multi-head attention model—and can occur through cascades of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias.
